items.question: Is there an in-game map?
items.answer: No conventional map. Use monuments, the coast and major structures as landmarks, or follow the next-milestone guide when lost.

items.question: Does resting save my progress?
items.answer: Save and Rest are separate choices at Crystal Monuments. Save deliberately after an important pickup.

items.question: What opens new gaps?
items.answer: Holy Sword Endu gives you Wind Dash; later upgrades extend the places you can reach.
